THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Crispy Potato Skins

Zero-waste crunchy topper for mashed potatoes: save 100g of potato peels, rinse and pat dry, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning, and air-fry at 325°F for 15–20 minutes until golden and crisp.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME15–20 min air-fry at 325°F
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVINGSee nutrition notes
KEY TO SUCCESS: Pat the rinsed peels thoroughly dry between paper towels before oiling so they crisp instead of steaming.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 100g potato peels (saved from peeling potatoes for mashed potatoes)
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning

Allergens: dairy.

You just peeled potatoes for mashed potatoes and want to turn the peels into a crispy, buttery topping in the air fryer while the potatoes boil.

Method

  1. 1.RINSE & PAT DRY. Rinse 100g potato peels in water and pat them thoroughly dry between paper towels.
  2. 2.TOSS WITH OLIVE OIL & BUTTER SEASONING. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning and toss until the peels are evenly coated.
  3. 3.AIR-FRY AT 325°F (15–20 MIN). Spread the seasoned peels in the air-fryer basket and air-fry at 325°F for 15–20 minutes until golden brown and crisp, checking starting at 15 minutes.
  4. 4.TOP THE MASH & SERVE. Pile the crispy potato skins on top of Protein Mashed Popcorn right before serving so they stay crisp.

Keys to success

  • Start checking the air fryer at 15 minutes at 325°F since thin peels brown quickly once their moisture evaporates.
  • Add the crispy skins to the mashed potatoes right before serving so they keep their crunch.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best eaten fresh out of the air fryer while crisp.

Reheat: Re-crisp at 325°F in the air fryer for 2–3 minutes.

Lasts: Enjoy same day; re-crisp in the air fryer if needed.
